questions.question_text: Read the provided unseen passage discussing the impact of digital fatigue on adolescent sleep cycles. According to the author, what is the primary biological reason that excessive screen time disrupts sleep?
options: A) The continuous influx of stressful news notifications
B) The emission of blue light which suppresses melatonin production
C) The physical strain on the ocular muscles leading to headaches
D) The excessive consumption of late-night digital entertainment
questions.answer: B) The emission of blue light which suppresses melatonin production

questions.question_text: Identify the word from paragraph 2 that is the exact antonym of 'beneficial' as used in the context of nocturnal habits.
questions.answer: C) Detrimental

questions.question_text: Based on the researcher's findings in the passage, fill in the blank: The practice of turning off all electronic devices an hour before bed is referred to as a digital _______.
questions.answer: C) Sunset

questions.question_text: How does chronic sleep deprivation specifically affect the cognitive performance of high school students during morning hours? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Chronic sleep deprivation significantly impairs short-term memory retention and reduces the attention span of students. This leads to a decreased ability to process complex information and solve problems effectively during morning classes.

questions.question_text: State two practical lifestyle modifications suggested by the author to restore a healthy circadian rhythm. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The author suggests maintaining a strict, consistent bedtime every night, including weekends, and completely replacing digital screen usage with reading physical books or practicing meditation at least one hour before sleeping.

questions.question_text: What underlying assumption does the author make about the relationship between physical outdoor activity and nocturnal rest? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The author assumes that engaging in regular outdoor physical activity during daylight hours naturally exhausts the body and regulates hormone levels, thereby acting as a biological catalyst for deeper, uninterrupted sleep at night.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank demonstrating Subject-Verb Concord: 'Neither the principal nor the teachers _______ present at the seminar yesterday.'
questions.answer: B) were

questions.question_text: Identify the correct tense form to complete the sentence: 'By the time the rescue team arrived, the local villagers _______ the trapped animals.'
questions.answer: C) had saved

questions.question_text: Select the appropriate modal auxiliary to indicate a strong moral obligation: 'We _______ respect the environmental guidelines to protect our local wildlife.'
questions.answer: C) ought to

questions.question_text: Identify the error in the given sentence and provide the correction: 'Every one of the students have submitted their assignment on time.'
questions.answer: B) Error: have, Correction: has

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct determiner: 'There is _______ hope of his recovery as the injuries are quite severe.'
questions.answer: B) little

questions.question_text: Transform the following direct speech into reported speech: The teacher said to the students, "Have you completed the science project?"
options: A) The teacher asked the students if they had completed the science project.
B) The teacher told the students if they have completed the science project.
C) The teacher asked the students whether they have completed the science project.
D) The teacher ordered the students that they had completed the science project.
questions.answer: A) The teacher asked the students if they had completed the science project.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct modal to express a theoretical possibility: 'The new software update _______ cause some older devices to run slowly.'
questions.answer: C) may

questions.question_text: Select the correct verb form to complete the sentence based on tense rules: 'I _______ for this company since it was established in 2015.'
questions.answer: C) have been working

questions.question_text: Write a formal letter to the Editor of a national daily expressing your concern over the increasing incidents of cyberbullying among teenagers and suggesting preventive measures. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: Sir, Through the columns of your esteemed newspaper, I wish to draw the attention of parents and authorities towards the alarming rise in cyberbullying among teenagers. With the surge in unrestricted internet access, young students frequently face harassment, trolling, and defamation on social media platforms, leading to severe anxiety and depression. It is imperative that schools introduce mandatory cyber safety workshops to educate students about digital etiquette and the legal consequences of online abuse. Furthermore, parents must actively monitor their children's digital footprint and foster open communication. A collaborative effort is required to create a safe digital environment for our youth. Yours sincerely, Kavita.

questions.question_text: Based on a provided bar graph illustrating the shift from traditional print media to digital news consumption among different age groups between 2015 and 2023, write an analytical paragraph summarizing the key trends. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: The given bar graph illustrates a significant paradigm shift in news consumption habits from traditional print media to digital platforms across various age groups between 2015 and 2023. The most dramatic transition is observed in the 18-30 demographic, where digital news consumption skyrocketed from 45% to an overwhelming 85%, while print readership plummeted to just 10%. Interestingly, even the older demographic (50+ years), which previously relied heavily on newspapers (75% in 2015), has shown a steady 30% increase in digital adoption by 2023. Overall, the data clearly indicates that digital media has universally overtaken print as the primary source of information, driven by the convenience and real-time accessibility of smartphones.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'A Letter to God'. When the postmaster saw Lencho's letter, his immediate reaction was to laugh, but he quickly turned serious. What trait of Lencho impressed the postmaster the most?
options: A) His excellent handwriting and formal tone
B) His immense, unwavering faith in God
C) His deep knowledge of the postal system
D) His desperate poverty and agricultural loss
questions.answer: B) His immense, unwavering faith in God

questions.question_text: Based on 'A Triumph of Surgery', what was the actual 'cure' that Dr. Herriot gave to Tricki at the surgery?
options: A) A complex surgical procedure to remove excess fat
B) A strict diet of only water for two days followed by plenty of exercise
C) A heavy dose of nutritional supplements and vitamins
D) Special gourmet meals prepared by the clinic staff
questions.answer: B) A strict diet of only water for two days followed by plenty of exercise

questions.question_text: In Nelson Mandela's 'Long Walk to Freedom', what are the 'twin obligations' that every man has in life? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Mandela states that every man has twin obligations: the first is a personal obligation to his family, parents, wife, and children; the second is a broader social obligation to his people, his community, and his country.

questions.question_text: Why was the young seagull terrified of flying, and what ultimately compelled him to take his first dive? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The young seagull was terrified because he believed his wings would never support him over the vast sea. He was ultimately compelled to dive by maddening hunger when his mother flew close to him with a piece of fish but halted just out of reach.

questions.question_text: In the poem 'Dust of Snow', how does Robert Frost use the seemingly negative symbols of a crow and a hemlock tree to convey a positive message? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Frost uses the traditionally ominous symbols of a crow and a poisonous hemlock tree to show that joy can be found in the most unexpected places. Their simple action of shaking off snow ironically lifts his depressive mood and saves his day.

questions.question_text: According to 'The Thief's Story', why did Hari Singh find it extremely difficult to rob Anil despite his experience? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Hari Singh found it difficult to rob Anil because Anil was a highly trusting, careless, and simple man. Anil's absolute trust in him made Hari realize that robbing a person who doesn't even notice he has been robbed takes all the thrill out of the work.

questions.question_text: Lencho had supreme faith in the divine but exhibited a complete lack of faith in humanity. Analyze this ironic contrast with specific reference to the post office employees in 'A Letter to God'. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: Lencho's character presents a striking irony regarding faith. He possesses such unwavering, innocent faith in God that he genuinely expects a monetary reply to his letter. However, this divine trust completely eclipses his ability to trust his fellow human beings. When the postmaster and his employees collectively donate a part of their salaries to keep Lencho's faith alive, they act as agents of kindness. Yet, upon receiving only seventy pesos, Lencho immediately suspects these very benefactors, branding them a 'bunch of crooks'. He ironically accuses the very people who helped him, highlighting a tragic flaw in his perspective: he cannot fathom that human beings are capable of the compassion he exclusively attributes to the divine.

questions.question_text: In 'A Question of Trust', Horace Danby was a meticulous planner who prided himself on his successful robberies. Despite his careful preparations, he was ultimately outsmarted. Analyze how the young lady in red manipulated Horace's psychology to achieve her goal. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: Horace Danby was a careful, calculated thief, but his ultimate downfall was engineered by a brilliant psychological manipulation by the young lady in red. She presented herself with absolute confidence, adopting the authoritative tone of the house's mistress. She manipulated Horace's primary fear—the fear of being arrested. By threatening to call the police and then feigning a compromise, she cornered him into a state of panic and gratitude. Believing he was earning his freedom, Horace eagerly agreed to open the safe for her, completely forgetting to wear his gloves in his haste. She expertly exploited his anxiety, ensuring he left his fingerprints everywhere, thus executing a perfect robbery herself while leaving Horace to face the legal consequences.
